items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Let's see. Joe Harris. Now what did he play? Clifford Brown. Saxophone. Good saxophone player.

ctx.x: He played with Daniel. Daniel. He died too. You do. Who else was in that band?

Let's see. Joe Harris. Now what did he play? Clifford Brown. Saxophone. Good saxophone player. Joe Harris. He's still alive. I think I know him. Yeah. He's living. Yeah. Joe Harris. Sammy Penn. Sammy Penn. Sammy Penn. He was in the band. Sammy Penn. There's no warning. And the guy by the name of Freddie Jones. He played trumpet. Give me an extra bag.

Do you have a clarinet at all? Only saxophone? Let's see. Only saxophone. Joe Harris. Freddie what? Freddie Jones. I don't know Freddie Jones at all. You already know him. Is he alive? Sure. That's funny. I never heard of him. I can't play.
